recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not change definition to 1..1 unless a future work-group decision explicitly supersedes the FHIR-16359 modified resolution and the current guidance for non-true search parameters.
issue_request: FHIR-16359 asked that CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.searchParam.definition become effectively required when a computable search parameter is declared. The final Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution instead required a usage note: the element SHALL be populated if the search parameter refers to a SearchParameter defined by core FHIR or external IGs.
initial_application: Git-svn commit a4513eabdaf4c85c13820b36cc9216261c71caa4, titled GF#16359 - add note about status of CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.searchParam.definition, references svn revision 13887 and added the accepted note to the CapabilityStatement spreadsheet source. Current source retains that note in the generated StructureDefinition input.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes capabilitystatement=CapabilityStatement and assigns CapabilityStatement to conformance with first normative version 4.0.0. Current source keeps CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.searchParam.definition at 0..1. Later same-area guidance in FHIR-46110/commit 4bf721b04fa1d03d77120c37f1b206c594dea3f6 says non-true search parameters such as _format and _count omit .definition and use type special, reinforcing that universal 1..1 cardinality would be wrong.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml already includes the FHIR-16359 SHALL-populate note in both definition and comment, while preserving optional cardinality for cases where a searchParam entry is not a true SearchParameter.
